releaseTitle: Hotspot Manager v1.7.1 - CPU Fix + Revenue Dashboard + Stability
releaseNotes:
• 🔧 FIXED: App no longer crashes/exits when tapping Active Sessions (duplicate key crash resolved + new session detail bottom sheet)
• 🔧 FIXED: Expired vouchers can no longer be reused (exact quota/time cutoff now kernel-enforced)
• 🔧 FIXED: Router CPU spike caused by excessive API polling (probe throttled 5s->60s, quota read from session comment)
• 💰 NEW: Revenue Hero on Dashboard - total Ks sales, vouchers sold, top profile, data consumed
• 🛡️ V3 AirTight enforcement deployed to all routers (exact byte/time cutoff, boot self-heal, auto-reboot)
